decision_units.goal: 完成 Chapter 12.4：将现有 pre-command 权限薄包装扩展为只对 active Policy 禁止自动执行的规范高风险 action 构造绑定当前 task/base/subject/Policy 的 hook_pre_command high_risk_command immutable observation，并恰一次委派 12.2 共享 service 记录拒绝；Hook 不执行命令、不解析自由 shell、不消费 action approval、不复制 Policy/decision 表，自动允许的非高风险 action 保持无 observation 副作用。
planned_actions: Preserve the existing structured action/target interface and Policy-derived automatic permission decision
Resolve an explicit or unique active task only for Policy-denied high-risk actions
Construct one immutable hook_pre_command high_risk_command observation bound to the current task, base, subject and active Policy
Delegate the parsed observation exactly once to the existing apply_observation service with a fixed non-user-controlled Hook actor
Keep automatically allowed actions observation-free and keep every high-risk action denied after successful audit
Propagate task, target, Git, Policy, classification, state, audit and persistence failures through the existing fail-closed Hook error path
Add focused wrapper and real temporary-repository coverage for all six high-risk actions, every route, replay idempotency and failure behavior
Project only Chapter 12.4 after implementation, formal verification and required review facts are current
